I selected and finished `candidate_01`. It keeps the seed's geometry unchanged and adds room uses plus reconciled notes.

**Executed checks**
- **Overlay:** I overlaid the seed on `1f_view.png` using the 10 m × 20 m outer dimensions. The 8 spaces, walls, stepped SE room wall, doors and windows all line up with the plan. I saw no substantive discrepancy, so I made no geometry edits.
- **Space relations:** I ran 4 sampled point-pair checks (3 separate-space, 1 same-space) and all agreed with the source. This is not a whole-floor fidelity check.
- **Opening heights:** I compared the source opening heights against the North, South, East and West elevation labels. The exterior door at 0.2–2.6 m, the windows at 1.0–2.8 m and the large windows at 1.0–3.4 m all match. These are visual comparisons only: `check_openings` still reports no image-linked height claims for any of the 21 openings.
- **Interior doors:** They stay at an assumed 2.1 m.

**Room uses** (all inferred from furniture symbols, since the drawing has no text labels):

| Space | Role |
|---|---|
| F1_S01 | office |
| F1_S02 | office/enclosed |
| F1_S06 | office/enclosed |
| F1_S08 | office/enclosed |
| F1_S07 | conference/meeting/multipurpose |
| F1_S05 | conference/meeting/multipurpose (tentative; dining or training also plausible) |
| F1_S03 | corridor |
| F1_S04 | unknown (a cabinet-like symbol only; storage possible) |

I also replaced the obsolete "room uses not assigned" note with the current assumptions and unresolved items.

**Still open**
- **Calibration:** The pixel-to-world calibration was supplied by me and is not independently verified.
- **Doors:** I did not re-measure individual interior door positions or swings.
- **Elevation-to-plan matching:** It rests on dimension chains only.
- **Whole-drawing fidelity:** It remains not evaluated.
